description: This file defines the ClientRepository class implementing the ClientRepositoryInterface for OAuth2 client management within the SuiteCRM API. It includes methods to retrieve and validate OAuth2 clients, interacting with the OAuth2Clients data model.

classes.name: ClientRepository
classes.description: Implementation of the OAuth2 ClientRepository interface for managing OAuth2 clients in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: getClientEntity
methods.description: Retrieves a client entity by its identifier, returning a configured ClientEntity object or null if not found.

methods.name: validateClient
methods.description: Validates client credentials and grant type, returning true if valid, false otherwise.
